findings.current:
Namho knew some of what had happened, but he didn’t go into detail.

There was nothing more embarrassing than praising myself, and I’d find out naturally anyway.
findings.defect: The draft makes Namho the one withholding details and Jin the one who will learn them. Both actions belong the other way around.
findings.rationale: Jin chooses not to elaborate because it would feel like praising himself; Namho will learn the rest in time.
findings.replacement:
Namho knew some of what had happened, but I didn’t go into detail.

There was nothing more embarrassing than praising myself, and he’d find out naturally anyway.
findings.source:
남호도 어느 정도의 사정은 알고 있었지만, 굳이 자세히 말하지는 않았다.

내 얼굴에 스스로 금칠하는 것만큼 낯간지러운 일도 없고, 어차피 자연스럽게 알게 될 일이니까.

findings.current: When I first visited the Sichuan Tang Clan a few months ago, I was pretty sure hidden weapons had come flying at me. This time, the gate opened before anyone had even finished speaking.
findings.defect: The gate opens before Jin can so much as open his mouth, not before someone finishes speaking.
findings.rationale: 입 벙긋하기도 전에 describes Jin not getting a chance to speak, emphasizing how quickly he is recognized.
findings.replacement: When I first visited the Sichuan Tang Clan a few months ago, I was pretty sure hidden weapons had come flying at me. This time, the gate opened before I could even open my mouth.
findings.source: 몇 달 전 처음 사천당가를 찾았을 때만 해도 암기부터 날아왔던 것 같은데, 지금은 입 벙긋하기도 전에 문이 열렸다.

findings.current: The invisible rift that had kept them divided all this time had closed. They had united, and together they were rising from their grief.
findings.defect: The draft turns the halting of an ongoing rift into its complete closure.
findings.rationale: 멈추고 says they stopped its continuation; it does not establish that the rift has fully closed.
findings.replacement: They had stopped the invisible rift that had persisted all this time, coming together to rise above their grief.
findings.source: 지금까지 줄곧 이어졌던 보이지 않는 균열을 멈추고, 하나가 되어 슬픔을 딛고 일어나고 있었다.

findings.defect: Jin supplies the word for martial fortune, not a wish for warfare.
findings.rationale: Ju Wongong is struggling to recall 무운, which he then repeats in his blessing.

summary: Several localized errors alter who acts or what happens, including the account of Namho and the timing of the gate opening.
